# Search notes likely containing David Fincher / Fincher / movies
queries=['David Fincher','Fincher','fincher','movie recommendations','recommendations','movies']
all_results=[]
for q in queries:
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    found=[]
    while True:
        resp=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_token, query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at')
        print('query',q,'page',page_index,'resp_type',type(resp),'len',len(resp) if resp else 0)
        if not resp:
            break
        found.extend(resp)
        # If fewer than limit, assume last page
        if isinstance(resp,list) and len(resp)<page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    # collect unique by note_id
    for n in found:
        all_results.append((q,n['note_id'],n.get('title'),n.get('updated_at'),n.get('pinned'),n.get('tags')))

print('total_note_hits',len(all_results))
# Show top unique notes
unique={}
for item in all_results:
    note_id=item[1]
    unique[note_id]=item
# sort by updated_at desc if available
sorted_notes=sorted(unique.values(), key=lambda x: x[3] if x[3] is not None else '', reverse=True)
print('unique_notes',len(sorted_notes))
print('top10')

# Fetch Simple Note movie recommendations and extract movies directed by David Fincher
simple_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
simple_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=simple_pw)['access_token']
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=simple_token, note_id=1608)
content=note.get('content','')
print('content_len',len(content))

# Parse: title lines start with nothing and then movie title; director lines contain '- director:'
lines=content.splitlines()
movies=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None
for line in lines:
    line=line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    if line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # title line: likely doesn't start with '-' and doesn't contain ':'
    if (not line.startswith('-')) and (': ' not in line) and ('director' not in line.lower()):
        # Could be a section header, but in this note titles are plain
        current_title=line
        current_director=None
        continue
    if line.startswith('- director:'):
        current_director=line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
        if current_title:
            movies.append({'title':current_title,'director':current_director})
        continue

fincher_titles=sorted({m['title'] for m in movies if 'David Fincher' in m['director']})
print('all_fincher_titles',fincher_titles)

# Login phone and send to Christopher
phone_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='3155673041', password=phone_pw)['access_token']
christopher_phone='4275730168'
message=', '.join(fincher_titles)
print('sending_message',message)
resp=apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=christopher_phone, message=message, access_token=phone_token)
print('send_resp',resp)
